purpose: User-owned workflow routing and evidence observability for the academy-to-Main-Sheet project.
scope: Project files and supported task tools. This contract does not control the managed assistant, its model, permissions, context window, security, or network settings.
execution: Use the existing pinned Bun executable. If bun is absent from PATH, invoke its already verified executable path or prepend its bin directory for the current command only.
The workflow command never installs dependencies or launches a service, browser, sign-in, API call, next action, or file manager.

Status reads only its fixed checkpoint. Doctor additionally reads the fixed integration registry and two fixed project pointer dates, and reuses the existing backend dependency doctor. It never follows referenced commands or files.
Thunar is a file manager. Executable presence does not establish a running desktop, access to an arbitrary path, or managed-runtime control.
A successful exit means the requested local check passed. It does not mean the academy pipeline is complete or currently authorized.

Context reads only the canonical checkpoint and emits a Lead briefing. References and next steps are metadata; the command never reads their contents, dispatches agents, executes checks, calls APIs, or installs hooks.

checkpoint.owner: The task lead updates this small snapshot after a verified state change; no background writer is installed.
checkpoint.relationship: This separate operational snapshot does not replace or rewrite the existing archival Cloud/evaluation pointers, roster authority, or production effect gates.
checkpoint.content: Sanitized milestone enums, one step owner, one next-action enum, observation time, optional filename/hash references to sanitized evidence, and explicit unavailable context metrics. References are never automatically read by status or doctor. No credentials, authorization codes, process handles, student names/IDs, raw source data, or private session material.
checkpoint.evidenceRule: reported_verified records another owner's report; verified is reserved for directly checked evidence. Synthetic substrate, live access, and user outcomes remain separate.
checkpoint.freshnessRule: Even a same-day snapshot requires revalidation at an action transition. A historical snapshot is useful orientation, never current student/date or permission authority. Future-dated snapshots fail the CLI.
checkpoint.contextRule: Used tokens and maximum context remain null unless a supported future product interface actually supplies them. This schema deliberately rejects guessed values; supporting real metrics would require an explicit schema revision.
checkpoint.engineeringContext: Optional bounded typed Lead continuity: confirmed user answers, explicitly unresolved assumptions, pending interview questions, disjoint ownership, and next-step references. It has its own update timestamp and preserves all dated operational evidence fields. Capability blockers remain separate from unanswered interview questions and never imply approval or host access.

integrationRegistry.rule: Use the one operational project/bot baseline explicitly per action. Preserve the second project while its intended role is unresolved. Consolidation here means one routing and evidence contract; no physical cloud merger, deletion, IAM migration, API enabling, or default-project change is performed.

routes.first: Existing exact-target connector or verified backend read contract
routes.fallback: Authorized UI only for authentication, genuinely unexposed metadata, or source/visual verification

routes.first: The task that owns the live sign-in process
routes.fallback: Recover through that owner after its verified result; a foreign process-handle error is not a sign-in failure
Report its specific failure; use the reviewed bootstrap only when separately needed and authorized

routes.first: Exact scoped read by the access owner
routes.fallback: Identify the missing resource/scope; successful GCP sign-in alone does not establish Drive/Sheets or LMS access

routes.first: Refresh metadata/protections, review exact before/after/recovery, obtain batch approval
routes.fallback: Keep the source-backed draft available until approved, then read back the same target

reviewTriggers: A capability or route fails and the next fallback could duplicate a completed or failed attempt.
A process/task owner changes or an existing task unexpectedly becomes inactive.
A completed implementation or test milestone does not advance the chosen user outcome.
Resource scope, target, permission, or student/date evidence changes.
A milestone completes and the next exact acceptance condition must be chosen.

acceptanceValidation.contract: Typed validators must follow the actual service response contract, including optional or incomplete configuration. Do not turn a desired deployment-readiness invariant into a transport-schema requirement.
acceptanceValidation.receiptRule: Before aggregate acceptance, retain only the allowed minimized receipt for transport and each independently validated section. A failed chart section must not erase successful transport or already validated unrelated sections. Never persist tokens, authorization codes, or raw student data to recover evidence.
acceptanceValidation.partialRule: Report partial acceptance explicitly. If source bytes are unavailable, do not reconstruct missing fields or mark unvalidated sections verified.
acceptanceValidation.retryRule: Failure after a successful read does not itself authorize a new token or repeated read. Reconcile existing evidence and fix the pure validator first, then follow the current action-specific authorization.
acceptanceValidation.observedTrigger: On October 1, an approved metadata GET succeeded but aggregate acceptance failed on basic_chart_incomplete because populated chart domains/series were required. The known UI already showed an unconfigured axis/series. The correction is schema-faithful validation plus independent section receipts.

nextUserOutcomeContract.scope: A preservation-first 48-row insertion preview derived from the existing sanitized receipt. The generator has no API, auth, cell-read, or production-write path.
nextUserOutcomeContract.review: Separate verified before-state from arithmetic relocation expectations and unverified native behavior. Preserve whole-sheet protection semantics; do not infer new editable top-input cells, exact freeze behavior, or Q:R expansion from row insertion.
nextUserOutcomeContract.acceptance: A readable exact-coordinate preview with explicit remaining native object, recovery rehearsal, and consumer-rebinding gaps. This is a review deliverable, not migration acceptance or deployment.

developmentPolicy.authority: handoffs/workflow-current-state.json engineeringContext stores current user decisions and pending questions; routing remains a command-selection contract rather than another progress pointer.
developmentPolicy.ambiguity: Ask for missing context before dependent implementation. Keep unanswered questions pending and dependent next steps blocked; proceed with independent confirmed setup and checks. Do not invent risk thresholds or promote assumptions automatically.
developmentPolicy.ownership: One Lead owns integration. Delegate explicit objectives, file or directory ownership, validation references, and changed-path/evidence outputs through available host collaboration tools. Concurrent editors must own disjoint paths; read-only reviews may overlap.
developmentPolicy.nativeContext: Root AGENTS.md and the native Cloud start skill direct the Lead to read workflow:context at task start, after compaction, and before dispatch. This project does not install a native per-turn injection adapter or hooks.
developmentPolicy.metrics: Model family is a user preference. Actual host model and capacity remain unavailable in this project metadata; configured values and inherited model selection are not observations.

commandSelection.command: Select explicit relevant package scripts or exact test paths from package.json; the Lead records the choice and its evidence.

commandSelection.need: Unresolved requirement or Google resource scope
commandSelection.command: Interview the user; keep dependent implementation pending until answered.

developmentPolicy.configurationScope: Current user authorization is repository Cloud .codex/config.toml only. Windows/local-host connection and local global configuration work are cancelled. Repository file readback does not establish effective managed context capacity.
